name: Color Picker
description: A swatch trigger with preset colors and a validated hex field.

anatomy.description: The swatch button that shows the current color and opens the panel.
Named swatches that commit immediately on activation.
The validated input that normalizes #rgb and #rrggbb on Enter or blur.

dos: Name presets so each choice is announced by more than its color.
Curate presets to the palette users should actually pick from.
Accept typed hex when brand precision matters.
donts: Don't use it as a theme editor; it is a single-value picker.
Don't rely on the swatch alone; keep the value text visible for verification.
Don't reject shorthand hex; normalize it instead of erroring.

examples.title: Presets and hex
examples.description: Presets commit immediately; the hex field normalizes #rgb and #rrggbb on Enter or blur.

examples.title: Live preview
examples.description: A controlled value mirrored on a swatch so the picked color previews in context.

examples.title: Controlled color
examples.description: Pair value with onChange when the color drives other UI.

guidance.useWhen: The user picks a color from presets or a hex value.
guidance.avoidWhen: A full design-token editor is required.
guidance.behavior: Presets commit immediately; hex input validates and normalizes on Enter or blur.
guidance.responsive: The trigger fits toolbars; the panel caps at the preset grid width.

keyboard.action: Opens the panel from the swatch trigger, or commits the focused preset.
Moves focus through the preset swatches and the hex field.
Normalizes and commits the typed hex value.

notes: Every preset swatch has its name applied as an aria-label and reports selection through aria-pressed.
The preset grid is a labeled group and the swatch preview is decorative.
Invalid hex input marks the field aria-invalid and does not commit.

props.description: Accessible name for the trigger button.

props.description: Initial hex color when uncontrolled. Defaults to the teal primary.
